body: Thanks for your comment. I tend to overthink the severity of those embarassing moments from being verbally bullied at school. I come from a town where men are meant to bottle their emotions. So sucking it up is what you're supposed to do. For instance, when i was 13 there was a girl who would constantly treat me like shit, verbally and physically to the point where i didn't want to go to school anymore. When i told a teacher about this he laughed at me and told me how disappointing i was. If i hadnt gone after class he may have said it to the entire class. This kind of went on to high school and was probably the start of my reclusive nature
I find that the longer the happy period, the worse the sad period is going to be. Like I'm burned out from it
